findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: designesy_catalog, designesy_design_review, designesy_score, designesy_tokens_score, designesy_a11y_score, designesy_motion_score, designesy_drift_score, designesy_readiness_score, designesy_guardrails, designesy_monitor_score, designesy_report · Private data: designesy_contract, designesy_skill_md, designesy_agent_json, designesy_llms_txt, designesy_score, designesy_tokens_score, designesy_motion_score, designesy_drift_score, designesy_readiness_score, designesy_guardrails, designesy_monitor_score, designesy_compare, designesy_report · Public sink: designesy_monitor_score · Destructive: designesy_contract, designesy_design_review, designesy_skill_md, designesy_score, designesy_a11y_score, designesy_drift_score, designesy_guardrails, designesy_monitor_score.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
